Changing only the scaffolded DISCOVERY template leaves existing client DISCOVERY files on the old `## Problem` shape; adopt preserves files already present. The plan does not say how discovery adds cards there (`factory/scripts/forge_cli/scaffold.py:174-190`, `factory/scripts/forge_cli/adopt.py:351`).

The completion and test language does not prove that the chosen card is linked into the Brief and spec, that the human's option and reason are recorded, or that factual questions use neutral choices (`docs/specs/fde-discovery.md:32-53`).

The confirmed spec directs agents to run `forge context harvest`, but the CLI offers only `scan`, `list`, and `mark`. The plan does not replace this dead-end instruction in the customer-notes flow (`docs/specs/fde-discovery.md:43-46`, `factory/scripts/forge.py:517-536`).

The plan names payback boundary tests but gives no executable examples or verification method for the agent's recommendation and the unknown-value case; the required `Verify plan` section is absent (`docs/specs/fde-discovery.md:55-63`, `factory/prompts/planner.md:49-52`).

Adding a mandatory Success measure without updating spec-authoring guidance leaves `spec save` help and the spec README describing only the old required sections, so authors can reach confirmation with a draft they were told was complete (`factory/scripts/forge.py:395-406`, `docs/specs/README.md:3-10`).

The proposed optional `due` column needs an explicit backward-compatible parse and save contract for existing six-column rows; the current parser is strict and `save_rows` rewrites the whole ledger (`factory/scripts/forge_cli/deferrals.py:28-75`, `plans/deferrals.md:7-10`).

Using deferrals for scheduled success checks also requires a disposition for the shipped stale-deferral audit: it flags every open row older than 60 days by its added date, even when its check date is later (`factory/scripts/forge_cli/audit.py:86-100`).
